definitions.gloss: to take time; to be time-consuming; to have difficulty with
definitions.explanation: To spend more time than expected on something, often due to complications or difficulty.

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}に{手間取|てまど}って{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: I was late because the preparations took longer than expected.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}の{手続|てつづ}きに{手間取|てまど}っている。
examples.english: I'm having difficulty with the paperwork procedures.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}った{以上|いじょう}に{手間取|てまど}ってしまった。
examples.english: It took more time than I thought.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{荷造|にづく}りに{手間取|てまど}って、{予定|よてい}より{遅|おく}れた。
examples.english: Packing for the move took longer than expected, and I fell behind schedule.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいシステムの{設定|せってい}に{手間取|てまど}って、{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}いっぱいかかってしまった。
examples.english: I struggled with setting up the new system and it ended up taking the entire morning.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
Pattern: [task]に{手間取|てまど}る

ASPECT:
{手間取|てまど}っている indicates currently struggling with something time-consuming.

・{手間取|てまど}らない (negative)
・{手間取|てまど}って (te-form)
・{手間取|てまど}った (past)

FORMATION:
{手間|てま} (time and effort) + {取|と}る (to take)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{準備|じゅんび}に{手間取|てまど}る - to take time with preparations
・{作業|さぎょう}に{手間取|てまど}る - to struggle with work
・{予想|よそう}{以上|いじょう}に{手間取|てまど}る - to take longer than expected

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{時間|じかん}がかかる - to take time (neutral)
・{苦労|くろう}する - to have difficulty
・{手|て}こずる - to have trouble with
